name: TRU Storm Pack
description: Bridge cards pointing at Lifeline, Water, Fire, Shelter, Cold, Signal, Pantry. Does not invent medical advice.

docs.text: Body. FM 21-76 Survival 1970 and FM 21-11 First Aid 1976. Source-bound; never generates. Full engine: splashdown1/tru-lifeline.
Emergency disinfection only after settle and filter. See Water pack and TRU Water lane. Not a substitute for Lifeline chapters.
Site, fuel ladder, dead out. No friction-fire recipe on this pack. Full card: TRU Fire lane on the shelf.
Site, size, poncho lean-to. No snow-cave recipe here. Full card: TRU Shelter lane.
COLD: clean, avoid overheating, loose layers, dry. No treatment claim beyond the packed source. Full card: TRU Cold lane.
Distress, panel, Morse, three of anything. See Signal pack and TRU Signal lane.
Food that keeps. USDA process times and altitude only. Full card: TRU Pantry lane.
Join is a folder, not a fusion. Save Shelf, Door, Search, Canonbound, Lifeline, Water, Signal beside each other. Radio off, you have only those files.
